notes: Hybrid v1.2: model 1 (rt_continuation_latest.onnx, as v1.1) while the piano is silent; the CHORD-TOKEN model 2 (m2c, v1.2_simultaneous.onnx = run ovn_m2c_r3b, vocab 14071, trained with all piano notes first at every joint onset as the engine plays them live) while it plays. Same switching rules as v1.1. Model 2 draws nothing for the first startDelayMs (3000) of a performance. Model 2: WAITs only on strong chords ([WAIT d >= 6][K k,+1]); at a fire one CHORD block [CHORD][SDUR][BASS][SVEL] (+ one leftover quad) decoded into notes for the OT with the voicing bank (voicing_bank.json in virtual_orch_models); at every window close the model draws [LATE d] (at most 2) or [EXPIRED]; after [EXPIRED] it draws a WAIT (re-wait, same K) or a CHORD (give up: the chord plays alone); piano durations are [DUR?] until known. Spec: orchestration/docs/model_specs/expressified_simultaneous.txt B3f; tokens: overnight/pkg/wait3.py.
